entries.question: What is an AI agent?
entries.answer: Software that takes on a job, not just a question. It reads, decides and acts inside your tools, within limits you set.

entries.question: How is it different from a chatbot?
entries.answer: A chatbot answers. An agent does the work: it checks the order, drafts the reply and asks when it isn't sure.

entries.question: What does "trained" mean?
entries.answer: It practises on your documents, policies and past cases, then is tested against edge cases before it touches live work. [Describe your real method.]

entries.question: Where does our data go?
entries.answer: [Region and hosting.] You choose what the agent can see. [Confirm any "never used to train other clients' agents" claim before publishing.]

entries.question: What if it makes a mistake?
entries.answer: It works within limits you set, risky actions wait for approval, and every action is logged so you can see what happened and fix it.

entries.question: How long until the first agent works?
entries.answer: [X weeks] from brief to first live job, depending on your systems.

entries.question: Do we need to change our tools?
entries.answer: No. The agent connects to the tools you already use. [List real integrations.]
